purpose: 既知development 1件について、構造表現とmaximum chunk集約の長文有利を2x2 factorial ablationで探索的に切り分ける。holdoutまたはproduction性能へ一般化しない。

structural.separator_contract: ASCII field name, colon, single ASCII space, value, LF; one final blank LF line
structural.repository_path: replace backslash with POSIX slash, then remove the exact leading corpora/github-retrieval-parity-v4/ prefix once
structural.document_title: first column-zero ^#  line outside fenced code, normalized marker remainder, else [missing]
structural.heading_chain: column-zero ^(#{1,6})  headings outside fenced code with line-start codepoint strictly below chunk_start; remove active levels at or below the new heading then append; normalize and join by ASCII space-greater-space; else [missing]
structural.fenced_code: opening is zero to three ASCII spaces followed by at least three identical backticks or tildes; closing uses the same character and at least the opening length; ignore heading-like lines while open
structural.whitespace_normalization: strip leading and trailing Unicode whitespace and collapse every internal Unicode whitespace run to one ASCII space
structural.body_chunk_contract: project body once at 480 codepoints with 80 overlap, then prepend metadata without changing body text, offsets, or hash
structural.application: apply identically and query-independently to every projected chunk of all 93 documents

normalized_log_mean_exp.rationale: normalize the exponential score mass by chunk count so additional independent chances do not receive the unnormalized maximum benefit

ranking.primary_success: at least one non-baseline arm ranks the expected source at or above cutoff for both pinned models
ranking.directional_evidence: the same non-baseline arm strictly improves expected-source rank versus body_max for both pinned models
ranking.length_bias_attenuation: for each pinned model, absolute Spearman correlation between chunk_count and document_score is lower than the corresponding maximum arm using the same representation

truncation_diagnostics.tokenization: model-pinned tokenizer; prefix add_special_tokens=false; query/passage pair add_special_tokens=true and truncation=false

forbidden: query-specific or gold-specific text, boost, weight, projection, or aggregation
mixed-stage v5 query or gold inputs
default retrieval or production rollout changes
retry or replacement of a failed registered one-shot

approved_axes: literal auditable structural representation and tokenizer truncation diagnostics
